craft_notes: Sthāyin: resolve-offering (intellect's flowers). Rows: row 2 (standing→bow). Close: bow (praṇāmi as the closer; first bow after praises). Rejected: 'mind' for intellect — killed: intellect-formed kept (buddhi precise, not manas); 'always' for ever — killed: ever kept (satatam refrain-word).

lines: Who Bhairava honors with resolve-blooms, on the lord's petal standing —
intellect-formed Brāhmī, her, I — ever I bow.
l4.sanskrit_cite: arcayati bhairavaṃ yā niścayakusumaiḥ sureśapatrasthā | praṇamāmi buddhirūpāṃ brahmāṇīṃ tāmahaṃ satatam

reads_against.argmap: Who offers resolve? → Brāhmī (buddhi, east petal) confirms outside perceptions and offers them as niścaya-flowers to the heart-lotus.
c1_essence: Brāhmī intellect-formed offers resolve-flowers from the lord's petal: perception confirmed.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder held in devotion)
